title: A red slice check from a flake stays cached across retries until the product or Check text changes

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Observed 2026-11-25 on S233 (run ork-20261125-015129-4c21). Round 2's landing slice check `go test -race -count=1 ./...` went red on the daemon flake filed as S544. Rounds 3, 4 and 5 (granted with `ork retry --rounds 1`) each ended "round N ended red: checks failed (slice check remains red; product unchanged)", because `runSliceChecks` (internal/engine/states.go:1086-1105) reuses a red batch while the product fingerprint and the Check section are unchanged ("Red evidence stays red until a product change invalidates it"). The implementer correctly changed nothing, and the orchestrator's own `go test -race -count=1 ./...` in the worktree passed. The only way out was to edit the Check text so the fingerprint changed. A flaky red can therefore pin a run for good, about 5 hours here.

The owner needs to choose a fix when this is specced, for example: a retry re-runs red slice checks; a red-only cache (rerun red, reuse green); or an `ork retry --recheck` flag.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go`: `runSliceChecks` reruns a red batch when the run record carries the retry mark.
- `internal/engine/engine.go`: `RetryWith` sets the mark.
- `internal/engine/resume.go`: `resumeStopped` sets the mark.
- `internal/runrec/record.go`: the `recheck_slice` field.
- `internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go`: the new tests.
- `docs/design.md`, `docs/state.md`: the cache rule and the field.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestSliceChecksRetryRerunsARedBatch`, `TestSliceChecksRetryKeepsAGreenBatchCached`, `TestSliceChecksRedBatchReusedUntilARetry` and `TestSliceChecksResumeStoppedSetsTheRetryMark` in `internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go`: an unchanged red batch is reused without a retry and rerun after `RetryWith` (paused and stopped runs); a green batch stays cached after a retry.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): Which fix stops a flaky red slice check from pinning a run across retries? -> rerun-on-retry: `ork retry` always re-runs red slice checks (force=true on the retry path in `runSliceChecks`, internal/engine/states.go:1061). Green batches stay cached, and red is never reused after a retry grant. [checks.red-evidence-retry]. How should this slice's empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check sections be filled? -> tighten: the owner picks the fix above, then the spec gets named files (`internal/engine/states.go`, plus the retry command file if option 1 or 3), a named failing engine test, and the Check `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine`, done when it exits 0 and the new test passes. The spec check would then be re-run..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine` (exits 0; the new test TestSliceChecksRetryRerunsARedBatch passes)
